# Real-vision evaluation: room1 (pathfinder.vision-protocol/1)

**Generated by `tools/vision_report.py` from run `20261115T165121Z-vision-room1-aaac9f1` (status: complete).** Real stereo images and the real single IMU of TUM-VI room1, replayed offline; faults are injected into images/IMU *before* the front end/estimator. No system receives the reference; no system is started from it. room1 is a **development** recording (see `data/exposure.json`): these are integration and development results on one recording, not an untouched final test and not evidence of general superiority.

## Frozen configuration

- VO covariance scale 4.0 and keyframe interval 4 (selected on room1 0–60 s, calibration run `20261115T164509Z-calibrate-vo-room1-db7015b`)
- IMU noise from the dataset's `imu_config.yaml`: {"sigma_g": 0.00016, "sigma_a": 0.0028, "sigma_bg": 2.2e-05, "sigma_ba": 0.00086}
- camera–IMU time offset applied: 0.0 s (measured 0.00017 s; protocol applies it only if > 1 ms)
- learned model: `models/dispnet_faults/best.pt` sha256 `611e97fdad4ac7735a3086179e059edb772f6d93d13a40c3b88b8d4bfec3eba3` (trained on TLIO headset data: cross-device here)
- initialisation: reference-free gravity start for every filter (odometry frame = start pose, velocity unknown)
- scoring: start-SE(3) alignment at the first initialised estimate (primary; drift fully visible), 4-DoF full-trajectory fit (secondary); never re-aligned per outage; mocap gaps > 50 ms excluded
- validity: VO covariance is not validated on held-out data, so every relative-mode output is `COVARIANCE_UNRELIABLE` and `valid=False` by contract; errors below are over **all estimated** samples

## Failures and harness errors

- none: every scenario × system produced scored output

## Runtime

- front end (decode + corrupt + VO), batch evaluation, clean room1: p50 62.7 ms, p95 221.3 ms, p99 283.1 ms per frame
- estimator `vo_only`: 30 µs per IMU sample (mean, offline replay incl. Python overhead)
- estimator `imu_only`: 2685 µs per IMU sample (mean, offline replay incl. Python overhead)
- estimator `conventional`: 2854 µs per IMU sample (mean, offline replay incl. Python overhead)
- estimator `pathfinder`: 2845 µs per IMU sample (mean, offline replay incl. Python overhead)
- estimator `pathfinder_no_gate`: 2873 µs per IMU sample (mean, offline replay incl. Python overhead)
- estimator `pathfinder_uncal_cov`: 2781 µs per IMU sample (mean, offline replay incl. Python overhead)
- estimator `pathfinder_no_adaptive_q`: 2897 µs per IMU sample (mean, offline replay incl. Python overhead)
- estimator `pathfinder_no_health`: 2829 µs per IMU sample (mean, offline replay incl. Python overhead)
- estimator `pathfinder_model`: 3607 µs per IMU sample (mean, offline replay incl. Python overhead)
- estimator `pathfinder_model_no_selfcheck`: 3650 µs per IMU sample (mean, offline replay incl. Python overhead)
- estimator `pathfinder_model_biascorr`: 3773 µs per IMU sample (mean, offline replay incl. Python overhead)

## Figures


## What this does not show

- No established external VIO (OpenVINS/Basalt/ORB-SLAM3) was run on the same inputs; the comparison systems are the in-repo VO-only chain and a conventional loosely coupled filter.
- One development recording: no recording-level statistics, no cross-device result, no untouched final test.
- VO covariance validity is not established; the learned model is evaluated cross-device without calibration.
- Runtime is a laptop replay; no headset, NPU, thermal or multi-threaded scheduler measurement.
